rules: Production routing code must not contain dialogue phrase catalogs or entity allowlists.
Production routing code must not contain regex-based conversational intent or entity routing.
Production routing code must not hide dialogue rules in top-level phrase constants or string maps.
Natural-language meaning must be emitted through a validated semantic structured resolver.
Entities are retrieval data, not source-code routing rules.
Deterministic code may enforce evidence, context, TTL, safety, rollback, abstention, and schema invariants only.
Natural-language examples belong in evaluation data and tests, never in production routing rules.
